adapters.exportDuty: Leaves with us: nothing to move for the record — every report and reminder is ours in platform_db (content_reports, reminder_sent), and Resend holds only its delivery log. MUST be exported before any switch: the suppression list (bounces, complaints, unsubscribes), account-wide on the auth+alerts account ([ADR 041]); mailing it from a new provider re-mails people who complained. Cannot move: sending reputation, which is the provider's and the domain's history with receivers.

delivery.domainVerification: mail.nikatru.com is verified on the Resend auth+alerts account (tooling/mail-transport.json rails[resend]); a send from the bare domain is refused 550 (trap auth-06), so every stream's From is on the verified subdomain.
delivery.warming: In service: the reputation of mail.nikatru.com on Resend is the one a target starts without.

adapters.exportDuty: Leaves with us: as for resend, every record is ours in platform_db. Export on leaving: the account-level suppression list (SES v2 ListSuppressedDestinations). Cannot move: the account's sending reputation and its production-access (out-of-sandbox) grant.

dnsNeeded.name: <mail-from>.mail.nikatru.com
dnsNeeded.expect: v=spf1 include:amazonses.com ~all on the MAIL FROM subdomain

dnsNeeded.name: _dmarc.nikatru.com
dnsNeeded.expect: the existing organisational record; aligned (relaxed) through DKIM d=mail.nikatru.com and the MAIL FROM subdomain

delivery.domainVerification: Create the mail.nikatru.com domain identity in SES (CreateEmailIdentity), publish its DKIM CNAMEs, and wait for VerifiedForSendingStatus; then request production access, which lifts the sandbox's verified-recipient rule.
delivery.warming: A new SES account starts with no reputation and a low sending quota: ramp the reminders stream over days, reports first.

adapters.exportDuty: Auth mail (confirmations, password resets) is GoTrue's own SMTP send through the Resend relay on the same auth+alerts account; it carries the same account-wide suppression list as the resend row. Switching it is a Box C env edit plus DNS, not code.
Nothing leaves: the fake records messages in memory for the life of the test and has no list to export.

reports.why: The support notice that a content report arrived (services/platform/src/lib/report-notify.ts), capped by MAX_REPORT_NOTICES_PER_DAY because the auth+alerts quota is shared with password resets.

reminders.why: The renewal digest (services/platform/src/lib/reminders.ts). Its own key when RESEND_REMINDERS_API_KEY is set; until then the reports key, under the digest's own small daily cap (MAX_REMINDER_MAILS_PER_DAY), which lane train-st-reminder-delivery owns and this registry never raises.

feedback.why: The feedback Worker's two consented mails about a person's own problem report: the receipt ("you may reply to me" ticked) and the one "fixed in version X" notice ("tell me when it is fixed" ticked), services/platform/src/feedback/notify.ts. On the reports key, under the notice cron's own per-run cap (MAX_NOTICES_PER_RUN), because the auth+alerts quota is shared with password resets.

auth.why: Confirmations and password resets: GoTrue on Box C sends them over SMTP (configured in its env, not in this tree). Its sender must be on mail.nikatru.com (trap auth-06); tooling/mail-transport.json is the record of the relay.

handTables.why: The stream → adapter and secret table is a hand copy of this file's `streams` until the port renderer lands; services/platform/test/mail-port.test.ts fails on any difference.

_why: L3: every Worker send goes through MailTransport, chosen per stream in the composition root (services/platform/src/ports.ts mailFor); no caller imports an adapter. resend and the fake pass runMailConformance with nothing pending; ses passes it too, as a draft no environment selects.

Senders are entity-source paths (tooling/house-identity.json mail.from.*, supportEmail), rendered into services/platform/src/generated/entity.ts by tooling/ports/render-entity.mjs; assert-ports limb 9 refuses an owner-domain address literal anywhere else in services/*/src.

The ses row exists to prove the port is not Resend-shaped: SES v2 SendEmail, SigV4 signed with WebCrypto, a different id field and error model, and no idempotency (so it declares none). Its secret names are declared on the Worker Env and not provisioned.
The smtp row is auth mail: GoTrue's SMTP on Box C through the Resend relay — the same vendor as the resend row, one port. Its switch is a Box C env edit plus DNS.

THE SUPPRESSION LIST MUST MOVE WITH ANY SWITCH ([ADR 041]: account-wide). Its export and import methods are null until Private/runbooks/switch-vendor.md#mail names them, so every mail dry run FAILs on it until then.
